$comment: Canonical course document format — ALPINE RUSH (integrate-ssxtricky-snowboard 3.2). The course is ANALYTIC: the terrain samplers (courseCenter/groundHeight/surfaceHeight) are the SSXTricky source functions ported verbatim and implemented identically in JS and Elixir, while the enumerable features below are baked into this compact document with its sha256 hash. Render and simulation consume the same functions/data, so contact and visuals agree exactly; the source's cosmetic bank noise beyond |x-center| > bankNoiseStart is render-only on both runtimes, exactly as in the source.

format.rulesVersion: integer, must equal contract.identity.rulesVersion at load time
format.hash: sha256 hex of the canonical JSON (sorted keys, no whitespace) of this document WITHOUT the hash field
format.lengthMeters: number, finish plane at this distance
format.renderSeed: integer, source LCG seed for render-side terrain colors/scenery (321)

ramps.base: number, groundHeight(x, start) baked at export
